source.table: Table B-5. Selected Measures of Household Post-Tax Income Dispersion: 2009 to 2023
source.title: Years 2023 through 2015 (10 year-rows × 13 dispersion measures)

unit_note: Post-tax income dispersion time series. All cells are level percentiles or printed ratios; under the frozen sum/percent-closure vocabulary every cell is standalone. Footnote markers on year labels (redesign/processing/population-controls) are recorded in the row label where they distinguish series.
